entries.title: Differential active adhesion and a capillary instability drive global eversion and dissemination of bacterial colonies
entries.summary: Nature Physics, Published online: 27 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41567-026-03530-x Chemical gradients help shape bacterial colonies. Now it is shown that these gradients can lead to a nonlinear shape instability in a colony of Neisseria gonorrhoeae.
